app.footer.about: Feliglot aiki ne na Felicity. AI ce ta rubuta kuma ta duba jimlolin darussan, kuma suna jiran masu jin harshen su duba su — idan wani abu bai yi daidai ba, ku sanar da mu.
app.home.eyebrow: Minti biyar. Sabuwar duniya gaba ɗaya.
app.home.intro: Gajerun darussa masu daɗi da suke farawa daga harshenku — ba na wani ba. Ku ji kowace jimla, ku faɗe ta da babbar murya, ku sake bitarta kafin ku manta.
app.home.pick.title: Me kuke so ku koya?
app.home.pick.body: Ku saita “Ina jin” a sama, kowace ma'ana za ta bayyana a harshenku. Kuna iya canza kwas a kowane lokaci.
app.home.how.eyebrow: An gina shi don ci gaba
app.home.how.title: Ɗan kaɗan kowace rana yana kai nesa.
app.home.how.hear.title: Ji shi
app.home.how.hear.body: Ana faɗin kowace jimla da murya, sau nawa kuke so.
app.home.how.practise.title: Yi atisaye
app.home.how.practise.body: Katunan koyo, sannan jarrabawa: zaɓi, rubuta kuma faɗi amsar.
app.home.how.keep.title: Riƙe shi
app.home.how.keep.body: Maki, burin yau da kullum da jerin kwanaki da suka dace da rayuwarku.
app.home.why.title: Abin da ba kasafai ake samu ba.
app.home.why.own.title: Koyo daga harshenku
app.home.why.own.body: Ba Turanci kaɗai ba: ma'anoni suna bayyana a kowanne daga cikin harsuna {n}, don haka mai jin Hindi zai iya koyon Jafananci da Hindi.
app.home.why.speak.title: Yi magana, ba taɓawa kaɗai ba
app.home.why.speak.body: Faɗi jimlar da babbar murya, Feliglot zai saurara — ainihin atisayen lafazi, kai tsaye a burauzarku.
app.home.why.remember.title: Tuna har abada
app.home.why.remember.body: Jimloli suna dawowa don bita bisa jadawali, daidai kafin ku manta da su.
app.home.why.content.title: Jimloli {phrases}, darussa {lessons}
app.home.why.content.body: Daga sannu da na gode zuwa otal, gidan abinci, lafiya da shirya abubuwa.
app.home.cta.title: Mintunanku biyar na farko sun fara yanzu.
app.home.cta.body: Kyauta, ba sai kun yi rajista ba. Ku buɗe asusu daga baya don adana ci gabanku a kowace na'ura.

app.course.intro: Jimloli {phrases} na yau da kullum a cikin gajerun darussa {lessons}.
app.course.romanized: Ana kuma rubuta kowace jimla da haruffan Latin don ku iya karanta ta tun rana ta farko.
app.tagline.ar: Larabcin labarai, littattafai da alamomi — ana fahimtarsa a duk ƙasashen Larabawa.
app.tagline.ar-gulf: Larabcin yau da kullum da ake ji a Dubai, Abu Dhabi da duk yankin Gulf.
app.tagline.ar-eg: Larabcin Alkahira — da na yawancin fina-finai, shirye-shirye da waƙoƙin Larabci.
app.offline.title: Ba ku kan intanet
app.offline.body: Darussan da kuka buɗe a baya suna aiki har yanzu. Ku sake haɗawa don buɗe sababbi.
